questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(11, 13, 143)

(17, 11, 187)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: (First number × Second number) = Third number.**

1) (11, 13, 143)

⇒ (11 × 13) = 143

And,

2) (17, 11, 187)

⇒ (17 × 11) = 187

Similarly,

3) (3, 4, 12)

⇒ (3 × 4) = 12

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'GOLF' is coded as '44' and 'BALL' is coded as '31'. How will 'PLAY' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The position of the English alphabet letters is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic: Addition of place value of letter + 4 = Code.**

1) 'GOLF' is coded as '44'

⇒ G(7) + O(15) + L(12) + F(6) + 4 = 44

And,

2) 'BALL' is coded as '31'

⇒ B(2) + A(1) + L(12) + L(12) + 4 = 31

Similarly,

3) 'PLAY' is coded as '?'

⇒ P(16) + L(12) + A(1) + Y(25) + 4 = 58

Hence, the correct answer is **"58".**

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two numbers and two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

+ and ×, 5 and 4

I. 4 + 6 × 5 - 7 ÷ 1

II. 5 × 3 - 4 + 8 ÷ 2
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Interchanged :**+ and ×, 5 and 4

I. 4 + 6 × 5 - 7 ÷ 1

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 5 × 6 + 4 - __**7 ÷ 1**__

⇒ __**5 × **6__ + 4 - 7 

⇒ __**30 **+ 4__ - 7

⇒ 34 - 7 

⇒ 27

II. 5 × 3 - 4 + 8 ÷ 2

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 4 + 3 - 5 × __**8 ÷ 2**__

⇒ 4 + 3 - __**5 × 4**__

⇒ __**4 + 3**__ - 20

⇒ 7 - 20

⇒ - 13

Hence, the correct answer is **"27, -13".**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(15, 9, 4)

(7, 2, 3)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: (Second number + Third number + 2) = First number.**

1) (15, 9, 4)

⇒ (9 + 4 + 2) = 15

And,

2) (7, 2, 3)

⇒ (2 + 3 + 2) = 7

Similarly,

3) (19, 13, 4)

⇒ (13 + 4 + 2) = 19

Hence, the correct answer is **"(19, 13, 4)".**

questions.question: Select the odd group of numbers. (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

Some grasses are trees.

Some trees are branches.

Some branches are dogs.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some grasses are branches.

II. Some trees are dogs.

III. Some grasses are dogs.

IV. Some branches are grasses.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions III and IV follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

Statements :

Some grasses are trees.

Some trees are branches.

Some branches are dogs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cb466cf3a72d7e8f43f2828e543c073a04419d8013a559e774e337d2e069ae0.png] 

Conclusions :

I. Some grasses are branches → **False** (As some grasses are trees and some trees are branches. So, some grasses are branches is possible but not definitely followed.)

II. Some trees are dogs → False (As some trees are branches and some branches are dogs. So, some trees are dogs is possible but not definitely followed.)

III. Some grasses are dogs → False (As some grasses are trees, some trees are branches, and some branches are dogs. So some grasses are dogs is possible but not definitely followed.)

IV. Some branches are grasses → False (As some grasses are trees and some trees are branches. So, some branches are grasses is possible but not definitely followed.)

Hence, the correct answer is **"None of the conclusions follows".**

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

× and +, 9 and 6
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Interchanged :** × and +, 9 and 6

Check all options one by one.

**Option 1) **7 × 6 ÷ 3 + 9 - 8 = 17

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 7 + __**9 ÷ 3**__ × 6 - 8 = 17

⇒ 7 + __**3 × 6**__ - 8 = 17

⇒ __**7 + 18**__ - 8 = 17

⇒ 25 - 8 = 17

⇒ 17 = 17 (Correct)

**Option 2) **6 × 8 - 9 ÷ 3 + 5 = 50

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 9 + 8 - __**6 ÷ 3 **__× 5 = 50

⇒ 9 + 8 - __**2 × 5**__ = 50

⇒ __**9 + 8 **__- 10 = 50

⇒ 17 - 10 = 50

⇒ 7 ≠ 50 (Incorrect)

**Option 3) **7 + 6 × 4 ÷ 9 - 8 = 8

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 7 × 9 + __**4 ÷ 6**__ - 8 = 8

⇒__** 7 × 9**__ + 0.6 - 8 = 8

⇒ __**63 + 0.6**__ - 8 = 8

⇒ 63.6 - 8 = 8

⇒ 55.6 ≠ 8 (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **9 × 7 + 4 ÷ 1 - 6 = 7

After interchanging the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 6 + 7 × __**4 ÷ 1**__ - 9 = 7 

⇒ 6 + __**7 × 4 **__- 9 = 7

⇒ __**6 + 28**__ - 9 = 7

⇒ 34 - 9 = 7

⇒ 25 ≠ 7 (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question: If A ÷ B means that A is the father of B, A × B means that A is the mother of B, A + B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that Q is the daughter of P?
questions.solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Given: 

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the Brother of B’.

 
 

 Symbol
 Symbol denoted Relation
 
 

 ÷ 
 Father
 
 

 × 
 Mother
 
 

 +
 Brother
 
 

Find:- expression shows that Q is the daughter of P?

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **P ÷ Q × R

(P is the father of Q, and Q is the mother of R.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b33865046b97b0afbc62e28a93440bdacf783b029b44cd338753f8260e76e0c.png] 

Here, Q is the daughter of P. (Correct)

**Option 2) **P ÷ Q + R

(P is the father of Q, and Q is the brother of R)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/634acefc84b754baf38556f8f3290b7e470c737bea4c89270dd785db2934510f.png] 

Here, Q is the son of P. (Incorrect)

**Option 3) **P × Q ÷ R

(P is the mother of Q and Q is the father of R)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a695682a2941a2ea0198db37ec47f2843f3c4c71f1d4b312181252ea2e59436.png] 

Here, Q is the son of P. (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **P + Q ÷ R

(P is the brother of Q and Q is the father of R)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c821c1349ea3db232dfa837a83b52648aac2dca694df9effc6348d0caa3ba38.png] 

Here, Q is the brother of P. (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
